result.stdout:
Anka - offline flashcard study in your terminal

Usage: anka [--help | --version]

  -h, --help     Show this help.
  -v, --version  Show the application version.

Run anka without arguments in an interactive terminal to import decks,
study questions, take exams, and view statistics. Progress is stored
in the per-user local application data directory under Anka/library.db.
